card.name: Digits inside numbers before time or quantity units
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 5, 6, 2 or 3 that follows a decimal point or "to" inside a number. It is followed by a unit such as hours, years, miles, million or billion.

modes.description: The digit after a decimal point in a measurement or amount.

modes.description: The upper number in a range of hours.
modes.example: at least 4 hours before or 4 to <<6>> hours after the administration of resins would
